_note: liberation false (temples, session 059): capturing it just makes it yours, with no bonus gold, reputation, alignment, card or conscripts, and losing it costs no reputation. sight: how far a building the player holds sees enemies, in hexes (round 9: towers furthest, temples middle, towns least; all doubled in session 067, user's playtest: enemies slipped behind the lines unseen). defense and rest (HP healed per day) are SPEC 6.5 placeholders: [other, matching] for towns and towers, where matching = a squad of the building's alignment; own_base applies to the side whose base it is.

temple.name: Temple
temple.taken_text: No gold or card for a temple, but it's yours: it watches 12 hexes around it, squads resting here train each day, and from here a squad can step through the Portal to any other temple you hold.

hidden_site.name: Hidden site
hidden_site._kind_info: Session 050 (user's design, 2026-11-11): a site shows its kind once seen; a squad stepping onto it claims it. Treasure, card and rare recruit are claimed once and leave the map. A secret temple is a temple from the start (GameState turns its type to temple). A lair is guarded by a neutral squad that holds its ground; once the guard is gone (recruited, or after any fight, as with neutrals elsewhere) any squad there gets defense and rest. Treasure: gold in [min, max] and an item (needing no tech) at item_chance. Rare recruit: one stage 1 race-line unit (none native to skip_terrains) at the median level of your squads.

treasure.name: Treasure
treasure.about: Step a squad onto it to take what's there: gold, and maybe an item.

card.name: Card cache
card.about: Step a squad onto it to draw a card.

secret_temple.name: Secret temple
secret_temple.about: A temple: squads inside heal slowly for free; pay to heal or revive in Temple services.

rare_recruit.name: Rare recruit
rare_recruit.about: Someone waits here who would join you: step a squad onto it and they go to the recruit pool.

lair.name: Lair
lair.about: A neutral band guards it. Once the guard is gone, any squad here defends +%d%% and heals %d%% a day.
